chunks: Mu'āwiyah ibn 'Ammār asked him about a woman who was ignorant that she should stone the Jamarāt until she departed to Mecca. He said:
"She should return and stone the Jamarāt as she had been stoning, and the man is likewise."

key_terms.الْجِمَارَ: the Jamarāt, the designated pillars/sites stoned during hajj
key_terms.تَرْمِيَ: to throw the pebbles in the ritual stoning
key_terms.جَهِلَتْ: was ignorant; did not know the ruling
key_terms.نَفَرَتْ: departed and moved on from Minā

ai.seo_question: What should someone do if they forgot or did not know to stone the Jamarāt before leaving for Mecca during hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for one who omitted the stoning of the Jamarāt out of ignorance and then departed to Mecca. The Imam عليه السلام instructs that such a person must return and perform the stoning, and clarifies that the same ruling applies equally to a man.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3002 - Mu'awiyah ibn Ammar asked Abu Abdullah (as) about a woman who, out of ignorance, did not stone the Jamarat before departing to Mecca.
Imam (as) replied: "She should return and stone the Jamarat as she would have originally done. The same applies to a man in such a case."
